name: fed_get_common_indicators
description:
Latest values of headline US indicators from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis), one lookup per indicator.
Returns: indicators keyed by name (series_id, title, value, date, units, or an error) and last_updated.
Inputs (none required): indicators (array of gdp, unemployment, inflation (CPIAUCSL index), fed_rate, treasury_10y, treasury_2y, sp500, housing, retail, industrial, m2, pce; default all twelve).
For history use fed_get_series; for any other series fed_get_latest. Key: the api_key field of this tool's config (a FRED key); the shipped config sets none, so the tool runs in demo mode and returns synthetic values with a note. fred_custom_series reads FRED_API_KEY and returns live data.
Example: {"indicators": ["fed_rate", "treasury_10y", "unemployment", "inflation"]}

indicators.description: Specific indicators to retrieve (optional, defaults to all key indicators)
Key economic indicators with latest values

last_updated.description: Timestamp when this data was retrieved (ISO format)

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Get a comprehensive economic dashboard with key US indicators. Ideal for getting a quick snapshot of economic conditions.
